sql.query: SELECT c.id,c.clauseName,c.clauseCode,c.clauseCategory,c.clauseHtml,c.clauseBehaviour,c.conditionKey,c.sortOrder,c.isActive FROM tbl_contract_clauses c WHERE c.id=:id AND c.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=c.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) LIMIT 1
